text: Hallelujah!Sing to the Lord a new song,his praise in the assembly of the faithful. [AA]
Let Israel be glad in its maker,the people of Zion rejoice in their king.
Let them praise his name in dance,make music with tambourine and lyre. [1] [AB]
For the Lord takes delight in his people,honors the poor with victory.
Let the faithful rejoice in their glory,cry out for joy on their couches, [2]
With the praise of God in their mouths,and a two-edged sword in their hands, [AC]
To bring retribution on the nations,punishment on the peoples, [AD]
To bind their kings in shackles,their nobles in chains of iron,
To execute the judgments decreed for them—such is the glory [3] of all God's faithful.Hallelujah!
